missions.title: Report Meeting
missions.description: RO635's Report: After attending a military party, Mister Kruger has decided to pressure Miss Persica to speed up the collection of Lyco's documents.

missions.title: The Last Supper
missions.description: RO635's Report: M16A1 suggests that I should gather some intel through covert reconnaissance before we start the operation.

missions.title: Acceleration
missions.description: RO635's Report: I've found the location of Document 7. It's time for me to contact Miss Persica.

missions.title: Unwelcomed Guest
missions.description: RO635's Report: We've started downloading Document 7. I wonder what sort of danger lies in wait for us…

missions.title: Shadow in the Sky
missions.description: RO635's Report: Dreamer has us pinned down with bombardment. The only thing we can do at this point is to wait for Document 7 to finish downloading.

missions.title: Mission
missions.description: RO635's Report: It's time to retreat! But, the exfil route has been…

missions.title: Parader I
missions.description: Persica's Report: RO and SOP2 have been successfully extracted. Commander, start the search for M16A1.

missions.title: Parader II
missions.description: Persica's Report: The Commander's search is still ongoing. I must continue my work as well.

missions.title: Parader III
missions.description: Persica's Report: Let's take a look at M4A1's condition...I'll give her a try with a new memory…

missions.title: Parader IV
missions.description: Persica's Report: The experiment is at its final step. That person...should be almost ready by now…

missions.title: Eagle and Jackdaw I
missions.description: IWS 2000 report: We suspect Sangvis Ferri may be in possession of CBRN weapons. We must let go of our past setbacks and take the initiative against them.

missions.title: Eagle and Jackdaw II
missions.description: IWS 2000 report: We have discovered a nuclear weapon in a S.F. base. Although it is a crude thing, Sangvis Ferri does not seem to be willing to give it up without a fight.

missions.title: Eagle and Jackdaw III
missions.description: IWS 2000 report: It was a trap! Sangvis Ferri tricked us with a cheap bait! Their true goal is to plant poison onto a T-Doll to kill the Commander!

missions.title: Eagle and Jackdaw IV
missions.description: IWS 2000 report: If the sacrifice of my life alone can stop an atrocity, then isn't that a worthwhile exchange?
